subject: EU batch VAT windowed reallocation / journal correction
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EU batch VAT landed in wrong posting window — needs journal reclass

Hi team,

Quick heads-up from the AR aging run this morning: the EU payment batch we received from Acme (see attached ap_batch_export_20270201.csv) looks like it posted VAT to the March posting window instead of January/February. That created a bucket of ~€48,720 sitting in a suspense VAT clearing GL that should have been recognized in our Feb period for revenue mapping.

Impact: AR aging and revenue recognition mapping both look off for Feb. If we don't reclass the VAT back into the Feb period, revenue reports and VAT remittance will be misaligned come month close.

Request: Can Ben draft the reversing/transfer JE to move the VAT amount from suspense (GL 2410) to VAT payable (GL 2420) with a recognized posting date of 2027-02-01? Lauren — once Ben has a draft JE I need you to confirm the revmap implications (deferred rev vs recognized) so we can update close packs.

Attachments: ap_batch_export_20270201.csv, invoice-ACME-INV-4123.pdf (sample).

I pushed a short copy of the affected invoice list to Drive (link below) for reference.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Finance Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cJE-VAT-windowed
HubSpot: HS-3421
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Acme AP <ap@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EU batch VAT landed in wrong posting window — needs journal reclass

On Tue, Feb 2, 2027 at 09:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick heads-up from the AR aging run this morning: the EU payment batch we received from Acme (see attached ap_batch_export_20270201.csv) looks like it posted VAT to the March posting window instead of January/February.

Thanks Grace — I pulled the batch and traced it. The payments were applied to the customer account correctly but the VAT line posted to a clearing account (suspense_eu_vat / GL 9999) due to our new payment gateway's remit date being picked up as 2027-03-01 on the bank file.

Next steps I propose:
- Draft reversing JE to clear GL 9999 and post VAT to VAT payable (GL 2420) with effective date 2027-02-01.
- Include a balancing entry to revenue deferral/recognition GLs per Lauren's guidance.
- Attach supporting remittance (if Acme confirms remit date) to the JE package.

I've created a draft JE worksheet (je-draft-20270203.xlsx) and attached it here. Before I post anything I need confirmation from Acme on the remit date (to avoid capturing an incorrect period) and Lauren's final revmap code.

Ben Carter
Senior AR Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments: je-draft-20270203.xlsx
From: John Sutherland <john.sutherland@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU batch VAT landed in wrong posting window — needs journal reclass

Hi Grace / Ben / Lauren,

Thanks for the ping — I've checked with our treasury team. The payment in question was initiated on 31-Jan-2027 and the remit file on our side shows an execution date of 2027-01-31 (attached ACME_remit_20270131.pdf). The bank's value date projected it to 2027-02-01 in some banks, but we did not intend for it to fall into March.

From our side the net + VAT totals match the invoices listed (INV-4123 / INV-4124 / INV-4125). If you need a signed remittance or an AP contact for a quick confirmation call, I'm happy to loop them in.

Please confirm when you repost the VAT so we don't double-up on filings.

Regards,
John Sutherland
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Corporation

Attachment: ACME_remit_20270131.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, John Sutherland <john.sutherland@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EU batch VAT landed in wrong posting window — needs journal reclass

Thanks John (and team) — that remit confirmation is perfect. Action plan below (please reply-all to approve):

Action items:
- Ben: post reversing JE on 2027-02-08 to move €48,720 from GL 9999 (suspense_eu_vat) -> GL 2420 (VAT payable). Reference: JE# pending, supporting docs: ap_batch_export_20270201.csv + ACME_remit_20270131.pdf.
- Ben: post a balancing JE to adjust revenue mapping: move recognized revenue for INV-4123/4124/4125 from deferred rev GL 3210 -> revenue GL 4005 with effective date 2027-02-01.
- Grace: update the Feb close pack and note the reclass so the tax team can reconcile for the monthly VAT return.
- John/Acme: confirm you will not reissue any remittance for these invoices.

Timeline: aim to have both JEs posted and documented by COB 2027-02-09. I will route the JE package to finance-ops@redwood.com for audit trail. Ben, please attach the je-draft-20270203.xlsx to the JE and include the Drive link in the description.

If anyone objects to the posting dates or GL mapping above, flag it now. Otherwise I'll treat this as approved and proceed with the JE routing.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference
